package v1

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

func TestLessonMaterialsRouteIsRegistered(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(
		&handlers.CourseHandler{},
		&handlers.TrackHandler{},
		&handlers.CourseLevelHandler{},
		&handlers.CourseGroupHandler{},
		&handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		&handlers.SectionHandler{},
		&handlers.LessonHandler{},
		&handlers.LessonRelationsHandler{},
		&handlers.LessonExamplesHandler{},
		&handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler{},
		&handlers.TaskHandler{},
		&handlers.PositionHandler{},
	)
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/lesson-materials/get/20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001?stack=go",
		nil,
	)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("expected registered handler validation response, got %d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}
